@w3c is rolling out Activity pages for its groups, offering a month-by-month overview of their work in one place. They bring together their charters, publications, meetings, participants, and GitHub activity.

▶️ https://www.w3.org/blog/2026/introducing-group-activity-pages/

The pages are in beta, and we welcome your feedback! https://github.com/w3c/w3c-website/issues

The project will also be discussed at #w3cTPAC during a breakout session to explore how this activity data could better serve the W3C community.
